caption: The four payload bytes 7E 8A 7D 11 become seven bytes on the line. Each byte that is 0x7E, 0x7D or below 0x20 is sent as the escape 7D followed by the byte XOR 0x20, while 8A passes through untouched, so 4 bytes grow to 7 and the overhead ratio is 1.75.

spec.title: PPP byte stuffing: 4 payload bytes → 7 bytes on the line
spec.aria: The 4-byte PPP payload 7E 8A 7D 11 stuffed into the 7 bytes 7D 5E 8A 7D 5D 7D 31, where 7D marks each escape, 5E 5D 31 are the escaped bytes, and 8A is unchanged.
